title: Hawaii Air National Guard Medical Unit Steps To Lava Efforts.
description:
As lava from the Kilauea volcano on Hawaii Island continues to threaten and destroy the Puna Neighborhood of Leilani estates.  Airmen from the Hawaii Air National Guard’s 154th Wings Medical detachment 1 have been mobilized to insure the task force’s Soldiers and Airmen are safe and healthily. 

Capt. Bryce Yamamoto

Along with the medial monitoring mission the Det 1, which is comprised of certified medical professionals, Emts, and nurses is also embedding with the roving patrols of the effected neighborhood. 

Capt. Bryce Yamamoto

As the disaster here on Hawaii Island evolves on a daily bases the Guardsmen are proving their resilience. 

Capt. Bryce Yamamoto

(U.S. Air National Guard Video by Tech. Sgt. Andrew Lee Jackson)
